@'
from envparse import parse_env

cases = [
    ("A=1\nB = 2 \n", {"A": "1", "B": "2"}),
    ("# c\n\n   \nA=1", {"A": "1"}),
    ('A="x\\ny"', {"A": "x\ny"}),
    ("A='x\\ny'", {"A": "x\\ny"}),
    ("A=hello  # trailing", {"A": "hello"}),
    ("A=a#b", {"A": "a#b"}),
    ("export FOO=bar", {"FOO": "bar"}),
    ("A=1\nA=2", {"A": "2"}),
    ("A=", {"A": ""}),
    ('A="  padded  "', {"A": "  padded  "}),
    ("URL=https://x/y?a=b", {"URL": "https://x/y?a=b"}),
]
for text, expected in cases:
    got = parse_env(text)
    assert got == expected, (text, got, expected)

errors = [
    ("A=1\nnope\n", "invalid line 2: nope"),
    ("1BAD=x", "invalid line 1: 1BAD=x"),
    ("=x", "invalid line 1: =x"),
]
for text, msg in errors:
    try:
        parse_env(text)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == msg, (str(e), msg)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(text)

assert parse_env('A="\\n\\t\\r\\"\\\\"') == {"A": "\n\t\r\"\\"}
assert parse_env("A=foo # bar # baz") == {"A": "foo"}
assert list(parse_env("Z=1\nA=2\nZ=3")) == ["Z", "A"]
mod = __import__("envparse")
assert [n for n in dir(mod) if not n.startswith("_")] == ["parse_env"]
print("all ok")
'@ | python -
